cards.label: DeskHub emulator
cards.subtitle: High-performance emulation with Rust Vulkan 1.3/1.4 core
cards.body:
WHAT'S NEW IN DESKHUB EMULATOR v1.0.9
• Upgraded to version 1.0.9
• Direct Input & Touch Dispatcher (Direct uinput & Lock-Free SPSC)
• Google AAudio / Oboe Low-Latency Sound Engine & SIMD Resampling
• Direct Storage Zstd Memory-Mapped Virtual File System
• Bare-Metal Inline ARM64 ASM Barriers (ISB/DSB/DMB)
• Zero-Copy Linux splice/vmsplice Wineserver IPC
• Ultra-Low CPU Wine & Direct3D (DXVK Async & VKD3D single-queue)
• Persistent VkPipelineCache on NVMe/UFS storage
• 100% Offline play & privacy-hardened environment
